content:
SECTION 1  
* Sajid Javid’s comments about millennials struggling to buy homes are very true according to the writer, who is 24 years old.  
* The writer often hears older people criticize young adults for spending money on things like holidays or meals instead of just saving for a house.  
* Rising house prices, fewer homes available, and banks being less willing to lend money make it very hard for young people to buy homes.  
* Many young people will likely spend their lives renting and paying money to landlords, who then complain that renters are not responsible.  
* Wages for people under 25 are very low—even full-time work might only pay around £14,500 a year—and they often have unstable jobs with zero-hours contracts.
